why: This editor's destructor takes away the timer or the look-and-feel while a parameter attachment is still connected, and resets the attachment after. Until that reset, the host can move the parameter (automation runs while the editor closes), and the attachment updates a control whose look-and-feel or timer is already gone. Reset the attachments first, as the first lines of the destructor, then stopTimer() and setLookAndFeel (nullptr).
